name: THE DEAD MAN’S HAND
provenance: Original procedural fictional revolver. Reuses existing project mesh utilities and exact pistol grip contact geometry. No third-party art or external assets.
coordinate_system: Metres; +Y up; +Z muzzle; receiver origin. Gun and hands share root, scale 1.
display_rotation: No baked rotation. For a side-on wall display, use the existing weapon display convention: yaw +pi/2 or -pi/2 according to wall facing.

grip.panels: Same panel vertices, walnut PBR material and separate fine checkering.
grip.hands: hands-revolver.glb is byte-for-byte identical to hands-pistol.glb. Preserve named RightHand/LeftHand wrist pivot transforms.

animation.fixed_parts: Thumb latch, frame, barrel, sights, grip, trigger, hammer, ejector rod
animation.note: Cylinder components are coaxial along Z and retain local translations. Group them under a shared pivot at cylinder_center for swing-out motion. There is no Magazine or Slide node.
